chunks: 2433 - Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام said, concerning the وصية of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله to Ali عليه السلام:

"Do not go out on a journey alone, for al-Shaytan is with the one person, and he is farther away from two. O Ali, when a man travels alone, he is misguided; and two are misguided; but three are a group. Some of them narrated: 'three are a journey.'"

key_terms.الشَّيْطَانَ: Satan, the source of temptation and misguidance

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about traveling alone?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys the discouragement of traveling alone and emphasizes the value of companionship during travel. It presents solitary travel as exposing a person to misguidance and vulnerability, while companionship provides protection and soundness.
